name: Aeternum Atlas — Production Live Smoke Test Matrix

tests.name: Homepage
tests.details: Root HTML returns HTTP 200 with viewport and Cinzel/Inter typography; mounts #root React app shell; zero missing asset references.

tests.name: Login
tests.details: Credentials form renders with Aeternum 26 Liquid Glass cards; password recovery trigger accessible; form validation prevents empty submission.

tests.name: Session restoration
tests.details: localStorage auth token key bound to production ref sb-hyivyrietgjdazgizafp-auth-token; hydration guards against stale state overwrite.

tests.name: Student dashboard
tests.details: Student dashboard route responds 200 OK via SPA rewrite; study telemetry and recent activity components verified by contract suite.

tests.name: 3D Library
tests.details: Anatomical catalogue structures, search bar, and system filters (Skeletal, Muscular, Nervous, Circulatory, Visceral) operable.

tests.name: 3D Viewer
tests.details: Viewer route responds 200 OK; Sketchfab bridge serializes annotation destinations; fallback illustrations (/pdf-medical-illustrations/) available.

tests.name: Quizzes
tests.details: Theoretical quiz service verified; error-to-flashcard mechanism contract holds (100% pass).

tests.name: Flashcards
tests.details: Leitner spaced repetition system contracts verified; decks retain study progress without duplicate or fabricated questions.

tests.name: Study Agenda
tests.details: Calendar starts on real current date; persists in canonical schema with server-derived RLS; zero client crashes.

tests.name: Modular Wall
tests.details: Collaborative study wall modules render in A26 feature shell without horizontal overflow.

tests.name: Anatomical Atlas
tests.details: 248 canonical anatomical facts and 154 entities intact; Latarjet clinical coordinates preserved.

tests.name: Profile
tests.details: Option A field honesty: full name editable and persisted via updateCurrentUserProfile; password change operable; academic fields read-only with institutional helper hint.

tests.name: Settings
tests.details: Language switching (PT, EN, ES, DE) and dual Liquid Glass theme toggle (Dark Liquid Glass / Light Liquid Glass iOS 27) operable.

tests.name: Institutional access
tests.details: Coordinator and Rector role hierarchy contracts hold; institutional admin is isolated from Superadmin routes.

tests.name: Password recovery request
tests.details: requestPasswordRecovery(email) triggers real supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail with dynamic redirectTo: https://www.aeternumatlas.com/login?mode=reset-password; glass feedback messages render.

tests.name: Atlas IA standby
tests.details: VITE_ATLAS_AI_MODE=standby enforced; immediate institutional response: 'Atlas IA está temporariamente em atualização institucional.'; zero 503s; zero calls to localhost.

tests.name: Vita disabled state
tests.details: VITE_AETERNUM_VITA_PIPELINE=off enforced; isVitaVoiceEnabled() returns false; LiveKit WebRTC handshakes and microphone gestures cleanly blocked.

tests.name: Protected routes
tests.details: Unauthenticated access cleanly redirects to /login; authenticated roles routed to canonical home without privilege escalation.
